items.question: Owing to his knowledge of historic buildings, Luis Harmon was ------- to lead the Main Street Restoration Project.
items.answer_explain: persuade somebody to do something 表示说服某人做某事；本句 Luis Harmon 是被说服的人，使用 was persuaded to lead，选 C。A persuasion 是名词；B persuasively 是副词；D persuading 若与 was 连用表示正在说服别人，需要交代被说服的对象，不能表达本句被劝说接任项目的意思。
items.question_translation: 由于熟悉历史建筑，Luis Harmon **在劝说下同意**领导主街修复项目。
choice_translations: 被说服；说服了（过去分词或过去式）
items.question_type: 语法题：被动语态与动词搭配
